content.text: Perfect! Let me verify the files and show a comparison:

input.command:
cd /mnt/user-data/outputs && echo "=== FILE SIZES ===" && ls -lh met_inventory*.tsv && echo -e "
=== CHECKSUM VERIFICATION ===" && sha256sum met_inventory_original.tsv met_inventory_standardized.tsv && echo -e "
=== ROW COUNT ===" && echo "Original rows: $(wc -l < met_inventory_original.tsv)" && echo "Standardized rows: $(wc -l < met_inventory_standardized.tsv)" && echo -e "
=== SAMPLE COMPARISON (First 5 data rows) ===" && echo "ORIGINAL:" && head -6 met_inventory_original.tsv | tail -5 && echo -e "
STANDARDIZED:" && head -6 met_inventory_standardized.tsv | tail -5
input.description: Verify the transformation results with checksums and sample comparison
